label: NCERT Class 10 Science, Ch. 10, p. 148
text: The angle of incidence is equal to the angle of reflection. The image formed by a plane mirror is virtual and erect.

label: NCERT Class 10 Science, Ch. 10, p. 149
text: A spherical mirror whose reflecting surface is curved inwards is a concave mirror. Parallel rays meet at the principal focus.

label: Lesson: Light - Reflection and Refraction · Mirrors
text: A concave mirror converges light; the principal focus is where parallel rays meet after reflection.

label: Syllabus: Light · Spherical mirrors
text: Concept: Spherical mirrors. Chapter: Light. Concave and convex mirrors, pole, centre and radius of curvature, principal focus and ray diagrams.
